import sys

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return
    n = data[0]
    b = data[1]
    a = data[2:2+n]
    pe = [0]*n
    po = [0]*n
    e = 0
    o = 0
    for i in range(n):
        if a[i] % 2 == 0:
            e += 1
        else:
            o += 1
        pe[i] = e
        po[i] = o
    wlist = []
    for i in range(1, n-2, 2):
        if pe[i] == po[i]:
            wlist.append(abs(a[i+1] - a[i]))
    p = len(wlist)
    w = wlist
    dp = [[0]*(b+1) for _ in range(p+1)]
    for i in range(1, p+1):
        for cap in range(b+1):
            dp[i][cap] = dp[i-1][cap]
            if w[i-1] <= cap:
                dp[i][cap] = max(dp[i][cap], dp[i-1][cap - w[i-1]] + 1)
    print(dp[p][b])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
